race.comment: UNWAVERING (11) is the clear top pick after her run in the G3 Red Roses Stakes, finishing last behind Lady Catalina in much tougher company. Her debut win at Kyneton was good and she's still got plenty to offer. Can bounce right back here. Quite a few dangers scratch away from UNWAVERING which leaves it open. WHAT ONCE WAS (14) maps well with Damian Lane aboard having won her maiden two back at Swan Hill before an even effort at Warrnambool. Should take catching. SATOSHI (10) is coming off a dominant maiden win at Traralgon, leading and bolting in by over 5 lengths. Fair bit harder now but can give similar cheek. AZZACOOL (7) should be ready to peak third up and has claims.
